# partiteai_judge_metric (Data Source)

A judge metric, by `id` or by `name` (exactly one must be set). Use the name to find one of the built-in judge metrics every organization starts with, such as `Instruction Following`. Requires an enterprise deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Judge metric identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Judge metric name, matched exactly. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) What the metric measures.
- `complexity` (String) Model complexity the metric judges at.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `examples` (Attributes List) Worked examples shown to the judging model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--examples))
- `input_fields` (Attributes List) Values a rubric supplies when it uses this metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_fields))
- `prompt` (String) What the judging model is asked.
- `scope` (String) What the model judges: the whole request or each hop between agents.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--examples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `examples`

Read-Only:

- `judgment` (String)
- `rating` (Number)
- `scenario` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--input_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `required` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
